description: This PHP source file defines the AdmonitionParser class, which is responsible for parsing admonition blocks in Markdown documents with specific syntax, integrating with the League.CommonMark Markdown parsing library.

classes.name: AdmonitionParser
classes.description: A parser class for admonition blocks in Markdown, extending AbstractBlockContinueParser and implementing BlockContinueParserWithInlinesInterface. It recognizes custom admonition syntax starting with '!!!' and manages the parsing state including optional titles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a specific admonition type and optional title, creating the associated block and title paragraph.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: Returns the current AdmonitionBlock instance being parsed.

methods.name: isContainer
methods.description: Indicates that the admonition block can contain other blocks, returning true.

methods.name: canContain
methods.description: Determines if a given child block can be contained within this admonition block, always returns true.

methods.name: tryContinue
methods.description: Attempts to continue parsing the current block if the cursor is indented or on a blank line; otherwise, signals end of block.

methods.name: blockStartParser
methods.description: Provides a static anonymous class implementing BlockStartParserInterface that detects the start of an admonition block based on specific syntax and initiates parsing.

methods.name: parseInlines
methods.description: Parses inline content for the admonition's title if present, using the provided InlineParserEngineInterface.
